name: Free Online Android Signing Certificate Generator (App Filing Public Key / Signature MD5) - atools
description: Free online Android signing certificate tool: generate keystores (JKS/PKCS12) for app filing, or parse existing keystores/APKs to extract the public key (modulus), signature MD5 and package name.
seoDescription: Free online Android signing certificate generator and parser for app filing: generate RSA keys and self-signed certificates entirely in your browser and package them as JKS or PKCS12 keystores usable with Android Studio, apksigner and HBuilderX. Instantly shows the public key (RSA modulus in hex, the “modulus” shown by jadx), signature MD5 (certificate MD5 fingerprint) and SHA-1/SHA-256 fingerprints required by China app filing forms. You can also upload an existing .jks/.keystore/.p12/.pfx keystore or a signed .apk to extract the package name, version, signing schemes (v1/v2/v3) and certificate fingerprints. Everything runs locally in your browser; keystores and passwords never leave your device.
